column1: # Theorems deleted from the models on purpose, in five groups. First, those
# the audit in formal/audit/unreferenced-theorems.md found nothing referencing
# (no proof in the dump's `uses`, no other declaration naming them, no example,
# docs anchor, claims ledger row, Rust comment, oracle or README mention, and
# no Audit.lean line except `Drain.orderInv_nil`'s, removed with it). Second,
# the rows marked "purpose review" or "re-review", which failed a review of
# their purpose (recorded in reviewed-theorems.tsv, or in the reason itself);
# header mentions, and the one Audit.lean line the reason names, went with
# them. Third, the #280 rows: that unimplemented design model, removed at the
# owner's request with its six Audit.lean lines, its README and header
# mentions, and the definitions only it used (a definition is listed only
# when nothing left mentions it). Fourth, the rows whose reason starts "#N
# fixed" (#316, #309, #310): theorems a fix of the Rust made false or
# redundant, namely runs of the Rust before the fix, which the fixed model
# makes false, statements about a branch the fix removed, and a special case
# that a theorem of the fixed model now states in general (named in the third
# column); their Audit.lean lines, README, claims ledger and header mentions
# went with them, and the reason names the theorem that states the fixed
# behaviour. Fifth, the rows whose reason starts "#350 Spec review": when the
# drain model was put in Spec and Proofs form, a Spec proposition was kept
# only for a guarantee about current Rust, and these were neither that nor
# used by a proof: rfl unfoldings of a definition's arms, the model compared
# with itself, statements about a loop, worker or rule the Rust no longer
# runs (the first in-session hold model `workH`, the replay without its retry
# pass, a superseded rule), a result a kept one states (third column), and
# the lemmas and definitions only they used
# (a definition is listed only when nothing left mentions it); their
# Audit.lean lines, README, claims ledger, docs anchor, Rust comment and
# header mentions went with them, and the reason names the current
# counterpart where there is one. Tab-separated: name, reason, the kept
# theorem that states the same thing or more (`-` when there is none). Read by
